top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a new, general chemical modality whose induced-proximity mechanism has been established with biochemical and structural evidence (including the cereblon target of thalidomide-type glues) and reproduced by many independent groups. Crews, Deshaies and Handa cover both the heterobifunctional and glue branches within the three-laureate limit; the cost is the omission of Ciulli and the lack of an approved degrader, so the citation should rest on the mechanism, not clinical outcome. C-N cross-coupling is mature and cleanly attributed but reads as an extension of the 2010 prize; lipid nanoparticles have unresolved attribution and a formulation-versus-chemistry question, yet both are preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my 3D electron diffraction work is only adjacent to serial femtosecond crystallography, which is not on the slate, and my Stockholm University colleagueship with Peter Brzezinski does not bear on any slate proposal
